description.narrative: The project will include the following components: (i) transmission system strengthening to further improve its energy efficiency and reliability and enable rural electrification in the Eastern, North Central, Southern and Uva provinces of Sri Lanka; (ii) rural electrification and distribution system improvement in the Eastern and Uva provinces of the country to expand access for the poor and rural households; and (iii) energy efficiency and renewable energy.

Energy efficiency labeling implemented for lighting, fans, refrigeration, and air conditioning appliances by 2013 Progress/Status: Partly complied. Standards for corresponding appliances (refrigerator and air conditioners) have been developed but regulations have not been published since the energy performance of such equipments under local climate condition have to be tested before setting the grading. Regulation for CFLs was published in 2009 and ceiling fan efficiency labeling regulation was published in February 2013. Regulations for linear fluorescent lamps and magnetic ballasts are not yet published
